title: Settings: push notifications and your time zone

changes.text: A Settings page, in the account menu at the top. Under Notifications, turn on push notifications for this device: a daily check-in reminder at 6 PM ET (only if you haven’t checked in yet), plus dividends, buybacks, bet results, replies, friend requests and exchange trades, with a switch for each group. On iPhone and iPad, add NASFAQ to your Home Screen first.

Under Display, show times in New York market time or your own time zone. Every clock time on the site follows and names its zone. Ticks, the check-in reset and Saturday’s review still run on New York time.
